summary: Harden #634 budgets with optional token_budget.per_action single-estimate ceiling: schema validation, AutonomyEngine.enforce_budget + get_budget_snapshot gate reasons/markdown, thin guidance note.
migration_impact: Additive .plate key autonomy.token_budget.per_action (integer tokens). Unset means unlimited per action (prior behavior). Operators can cap a single implement/plan step without lowering daily/cycle rails.
migration_guidance: 2. Optionally set .plate autonomy.token_budget.per_action (e.g. 4000) alongside daily/per_cycle and action policy.
3. Verify with gh plate autonomy --budget or get_budget_snapshot estimate that oversize estimates gate with : per_action.
4. risk_tolerance=off still skips AutonomyEngine enforce; snapshot still reports the limit.
agent_notes: per_action is not the same as token_budget.action (policy: pause|throttle|warn). Prefer pause policy for hard single-action caps. Do not claim #634 fully E2E-closed without operator proof of long /loop budget safety.
